parsed.draft_response:
Hi there — thanks for reporting this. I’m sorry for the disruption to your production order processing.

I can see you’re seeing “retries exhausted” for 118 events and that your webhook endpoint appears to have stopped receiving events from our system, even though you didn’t change anything on your side. We’ll need a bit more detail to confirm exactly which delivery attempts failed and whether a replay is available for those specific events.

Could you please share the following?
1) The webhook endpoint URL/environment you’re expecting events in (e.g., production vs. sandbox), and the account/store identifier(s) affected.
2) The approximate time window when events stopped being delivered and when the retries became exhausted.
3) The event types and/or identifiers shown for the 118 exhausted retries (a screenshot is fine).
4) What your dashboard shows for those events—specifically any error messages and HTTP status codes (if available), or whether they show as “no delivery received.”
5) Whether you’ve already attempted a replay (e.g., dashboard replay action/API call) and what happened.

Once we have this, we’ll escalate to our engineering team to review the delivery/retry history for those events and advise on the available replay options.
promised_actions: Escalate the ticket to our engineering team for review of the webhook delivery/retry history for the affected events
Advise on the available replay options once we have the requested details
safety_notes: We cannot confirm replay availability or success without reviewing the specific event identifiers/time window.
We avoid promising delivery of missing events until engineering confirms what replay mechanisms are available and the root of the delivery interruption.

parsed.customer_impact: Production order events are not being delivered to the customer's webhook endpoint, and the dashboard indicates 118 events failed retrying, potentially preventing downstream processing of those orders.
grounded_facts: The ticket states that the order webhook endpoint has stopped receiving events from the customer's system.
The customer's dashboard says retries are exhausted for 118 events.
The customer changed nothing on their side.
The customer requests the missing events be replayed if possible.
missing_information: The webhook endpoint URL/environment (e.g., production domain) where events stopped being received.
The time window when the events stopped and when the retries became exhausted.
The event types or identifiers corresponding to the 118 exhausted retries.
Whether any webhook delivery errors/status codes are shown in the dashboard for those events.
What “replay” mechanism is available (e.g., dashboard replay button, API endpoint, required parameters) and whether it has already been attempted.
Which system/account on the customer's side is affected (e.g., store/account IDs).
Whether the endpoint is returning errors (HTTP 4xx/5xx) or not receiving requests at all.
risk_signals: Dashboard indicates retries exhausted for 118 events.
Webhook endpoint stopped receiving events despite no changes made on the customer's side.
